stem.text: Two progressive waves travel in opposite directions and form a stationary wave. The graph shows the variation with distance $x$ of the displacement of the stationary wave and of one of the two progressive waves at the same instant in time.

stem.alt: Graph of displacement in mm against x in cm, with a horizontal axis from 0 to 25 cm and a vertical axis from -10 to 10 mm. Two wave curves are drawn, labelled progressive wave and stationary wave. Points J, K and L are marked on the horizontal axis, and the curves cross the axis at those points.

stem.text: What are the approximate displacements of the **other** progressive wave at the positions J, K and L?
